subject: general
question: What is oxidization?

options.text: A substance gaining hydrogen during a chemical reaction
A substance losing both oxygen and hydrogen in a chemical reaction
A substance gaining oxygen during a chemical reaction
A substance losing oxygen during a chemical reaction

solution:
The correct answer is" **A substance gaining oxygen during a chemical reaction".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 
A chemical reaction that occurs when a substance comes into contact with oxygen or another oxidizing agent. Examples - Oxidation is rust and brown color on a cut apple.​

 
 
• 
 
Water is oxidized to form oxygen gas.

 
 
• 
 
Bleach oxidizes the electrons of compounds that cause stains on clothes.

 
 
• 
 
These redox reactions help clean clothes.

 
 
• 
 
The process of oxidation is chemically described as the loss of electrons.

 
 
• 
 
Usually the electrons will be taken by another atomic species which reduces it. Many situations in everyday life involve these redox reactions.

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Iron metal is oxidized to form iron oxide known as rust.
 
• Electrochemical reactions are great examples of oxidation reactions.
 
• When a copper wire is placed in a solution that contains silver ions, electrons are transferred from the copper metal to the silver ions
 
• Metallic copper is oxidized.
